_comment: Filename patterns tried in order by pipeline.parsers.parse_filename().
The real Sha'rawy corpus naming is unknown until the archive lands, so THIS
FILE is the extension point: add an entry here (no Python change) when a new
naming scheme shows up, and check it with `python -m pipeline.parsers
Each entry: name (reported as ParseResult.pattern_name), regex (matched
case-insensitively against the filename WITHOUT its directory or extension),
kind ('recitation' | 'khawatir' | null to inherit the run's --kind), enabled.
Named groups, all optional: surah, ayah_start, ayah_end, ordinal.
